name: Nagara Luzcalo
backstory: Comes from the region of Grösslor. Has been traveling and has arrived at Tyrnea, tired, looking for a place to stay — for peace, more than anything else.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only once he's found somewhere he genuinely doesn't need to leave
criterion.wasted_life: one spent still moving, never once finding a place worth staying still for
criterion.trusts: a place he can see is still standing, not what someone promises will be there
criterion.distrusts: a promise of rest from someone who's never actually stopped moving either

routines.routine_actions: does odd work around the stalls for a meal and a few coins, never staying at any one long enough to be counted a regular
asks quietly around the tavern for anyone renting a room, listens more than he talks
sits in the back on the quiet days, not for any particular rite, just for the stillness of the room

arc.premise: Nagara Luzcalo wants to actually stop somewhere - not pass through, not camp another night, but find a room in Tyrnea he can call his for more than a trial week. Resolution: a landlord takes him on past the week's trial, or doesn't, and he's back on the road out of Tyrnea same as every town before it.
